description: An open coloring book lies on a yellow surface with a pink jellyfish-like drawing on the right page, and a Crayola crayon box sits to the upper right. The left hand stays near the lower left edge of the book while the right hand reaches up and right toward the crayon box, dips in to grasp and lift a crayon, then brings the right hand back down toward the book to continue coloring, making the crayon a right-hand object.
